workflow_description: Runs daily via Schedule Trigger, creates a new dated Google Sheets tab, reads search keywords from a Keywords tab, searches Amazon via ScrapeHero's Amazon Search API, splits results, filters for discounted items having both sale_price and regular_price, calculates discount percentage (% OFF), and appends/updates deals to the dated tab matching on ASIN.
business_benefits: Eliminate manual price checks with automatic scheduled daily searches
Build a historical discount log with automated dated daily tabs
Scale across unlimited keywords dynamically from Google Sheets
Filter out regular priced listings and isolate genuine discounts
Track competitor promotional cycles and find affiliate deal opportunities
